seo.title: Sahba El-Shawa
seo.description: Sahba El-Shawa is a Palestinian-Jordanian engineer, space and sustainability researcher, and social entrepreneur, and the Founder of the Jordan Space Research Initiative and the Palestine Space Institute.

bio:
Sahba holds a BASc in Mechanical Engineering from the [University of British Columbia](http://ubc.ca/), an MSc in Space Studies from the [International Space University](http://isunet.edu/), and a [PhD in Sustainable Development and Climate Change](http://phd-sdc.it/) at IUSS Pavia in Italy.

During her studies, she collaborated with the [German Aerospace Centre](http://dlr.de/) (DLR) on robotics research and completed an internship at the [European Space Agency](http://esa.int/)’s Clean Space initiative focusing on the environmental impacts of space activities, both on Earth and in space, as well as the ESA Φ-lab, where she developed a novel environmental feature clustering framework using Earth Observation and AI for impact assessment.

Sahba previously worked with the [Space Generation Advisory Council](http://spacegeneration.org/), acting as National Point of Contact for Jordan, as well as Co-Lead of the Ethics & Human Rights project group and the Space for Climate Action policy working group. She also served as Jordan's National Coordinator in the [Moon Village Association](http://moonvillageassociation.org/) and its Participation of Emerging Space Countries program.

She was recently named as one of 17 [UN Young Leaders for the SDGs](https://www.un.org/youthaffairs/en/meet-2025-cohort-young-leaders-sdgs) by the United Nations Youth Office. She was the recipient of the [Women in Aerospace Young Professional Award](https://www.wia-europe.org/2021/10/13/wia-e-grants-awards-winners-announced/) in 2021, the [Space Generation Leadership Award](https://spacegeneration.org/announcement-of-the-2022-space-generation-leadership-award) in 2022, the IAF Emerging Space Leaders Award in 2023, and was previously selected as an Alternate Astronaut for [Space for Humanity](https://spaceforhumanity.org/). She is passionate about outreach and education, and has organized space design competitions for students around the world including Canada, Europe, and the Middle East.

earth.label: Research
earth.title: Space-derived knowledge
earth.statement: Her PhD research explores the use of emerging technologies such as Virtual Reality and Artificial Intelligence to improve accessibility to space-derived knowledge for sustainability applications and policymaking, particularly through the lens of epistemic justice.
earth.current: Currently, Sahba works as a postdoctoral researcher in Earth Observation data science at Eurac Research in Italy.

ground.label: Analog research
ground.title: Analog astronaut
ground.statement: An award-winning researcher, Sahba is the first Jordanian and the first female Palestinian analog astronaut.

jsri.statement: She is the Founder of the Jordan Space Research Initiative, which aims to bridge sustainable development with space exploration through space analog research and education in Jordan.

psi.statement: She is also the Founder of the Palestine Space Institute, a think tank advancing the ethical use of space technologies and advocating for demilitarization, decolonization, and sustainability in global space governance.

vision: Guided by a vision of space exploration rooted in justice, sustainability, and collective responsibility, Sahba is committed to reshaping how space technologies are developed and applied. Her work bridges technical innovation with critical policy and ethical frameworks, striving for a future where space serves the needs of people and the planet.
